parameters.name: ConsumerId
parameters.description: The ID of the consumer group. If you do not specify this parameter, information about all consumer groups is returned.

parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The number of the page to return.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the instance to which the consumer group belongs.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of consumer groups to return on each page.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the instance to which the consumer group belongs.
